title: Runtime Evidence Envelope
description: A3 record: a signed event/transition linking runtime behavior back to the agreement, IR, binding, and runtime identity, in a sequence/hash chain. Produced by the network/runtime; SHOULD reference (not re-invent) the Fabric transcript. See docs/binding/TRUST_LATE_BINDING_CONTRACT.md.

name.description: State transition / workflow event (e.g. an OPEN..CLOSE operation).

transcriptRef.description: Reference into the Fabric transcript this evidence corresponds to.

previousEvidenceHash.description: Hash of the prior evidence in the chain; null for the first.

verificationResult.description: Runtime's verdict for this evidence (deviation classes are network/T4-owned).
